$comment: The files of the Unicode Character Database a pattern's classes are read from (spec 18.8.5, decision 0035), each pinned by its sha256: spec/generators/make_validations.py reads UnicodeData.txt and Scripts.txt for the verdicts of a Unicode class, and beadc's tables are generated from the same four. A version moves by a regeneration and a CHANGELOG line, never by a platform.
